audience: SAP professionals preparing for interviews or assessments and SAP leaders responsible for reliable, efficient SAP operations
useful_action: Route the visitor or retrieval agent to the canonical preparation hub for learning and assessment needs or to the canonical AMS improvement hub for operational problems, then continue into evidence-backed supporting material

editorial_opportunity.question: Strengthen a high-intent learning or AMS page with a direct answer, a worked case and an evidence-bounded continuation without creating a competing intent owner.
editorial_opportunity.proof_required: Use a current inspectable public artifact or an explicitly labelled synthetic worked example. Attribute external claims to sourceable evidence and preserve the strongest limitation.
editorial_opportunity.success_observation: Observe route selection and useful-action completion separately for Learn & Prepare and Improve & Operate; keep crawl eligibility, indexing, search impressions/clicks and independent AI citations as separate external observations.

constraints: Exactly two human-facing primary routes: Learn & Prepare and Improve & Operate; AI, Atlas, Labs, Skill Hub and machine interfaces remain supporting layers.
No fabricated first-hand results, reviews, users, credentials, endorsements, search metrics or AI citations.
ARWP validation demonstrates implementation conformance only; it does not prove indexing, recommendations, citations, rank, traffic or conversion.
Preserve verified/unverified knowledge, crawler-policy, privacy and publication boundaries.
